Each sense depends on a certain part of the body. This part receives the information and then the nerves send it to the brain. For example, eyes control sight, ears control hearing, and skin controls touch .Taste depends on the tongue, and the smell depends on the nose. There are also other senses which are equally as important. There is a sense of balance which stops us from falling down. We also have senses of hunger, thirst, heat and cold.
